canonical_thesis: Witness BC is the spiritual, cultural and archetypal Wildcard of Change: a Web3-native social commons built around memory, justice, exile, calling, covenant, freedom, storytelling, transformation and shared futures.
supersedes: All Witness-specific pre-Web3 preservation, institutional distribution, corporate consultancy and Stripe checkout instructions
p0: A welcoming independent social identity and living fictional world
Stories and reply threads under member-chosen pseudonyms
Topic-based Circles, real gatherings and member RSVPs
Founding culture rituals, collaborative fanworks and editorial canon
Community Economy authenticated member identity and invitations
Optional wallet and economic primitives, never membership gate
Member-led governance, respectful disagreement and right-to-reply
D7 return through meaningful cultural rituals not mechanical streak pressure
outbound_mail: disabled by default. A connected mailbox is not authority to speak for Witness.
revenue_and_economy: Community native economics, optional funded missions and verified crypto payments when actually supported and authorized; no fabricated cash or token.
live_status_rule: Pilot blueprint is not an officially founder-published community; member and XP records require real authenticated users.
production_rule: Deploy only allowlisted Web3 pages; reject any institutional services, corporate checkout, or outbound mail links.
rights: No implied venture equity, company IP rights, or profit share.
owner_signature_authority: Must be Witness-specific and explicitly authorized for any outbound communication. Never reuse another venture's account solely because it is connected.
future_agents: Never reinstate the legacy model without a new explicit founder directive.

visual_identity.rule: Expand Witness's own original light/Inter/slate/navy design with editorial, literary and cultural spaces; never graft BuildRelay or another venture's visual system.

symbolic_identity.rule: Archetypes are creative forces and mutable narrative roles, never fixed psychological diagnoses. Spiritual depth is voluntary; historical and religious traditions retain distinct identities.
